scope: Single Astra J A14NET high-priority accuracy and owner safety review
method: Manual review of live page text and cross-check against engine injection specifications and lubricants LSPI literature. Not Google quality rating and no word-length threshold used for grading.

findings: Very thin guidance on a technically complex engine, without any symptom-to-test differentiation, quantitative safe service method, primary source or useful internal links.

LSPI is prominently linked to Astra J A14NET without telling readers A14NET uses manifold multipoint injection; low-speed pre-ignition is much more documented for boosted GDI engines. Do not claim impossible, but do not equate ordinary knocking and LSPI.
Missing targeted PCV/vacuum diagnostics, fuel trim, boost requested vs actual, cold misfire, compression/leak-down and cooling system crossover.
